summary.headline: Vikram Solar Q1 FY27: record 1,006 MW volume (+32% YoY) and revenue ~INR1,563 cr, but EBITDA fell to INR126 cr (8.06% margin) as costs outran pass-through.
summary.overview: Revenue rose about 8% QoQ and 38% YoY to roughly INR1,563 crore on 1.06 GW dispatched, with per-watt realisation up 8% QoQ to INR15.02/Wp on DCR mix. EBITDA was INR126 crore (8.06% margin) and PAT INR19.78 crore, as unit COGS rose INR1.86/Wp from metals, EVA, and cell costs that were only partly passed through. Management attributed the squeeze to ALMM-2 uncertainty, Gulf-conflict input inflation, and industry oversupply. It declined to give fresh FY27 guidance, deferring the update to H1 results, and the Gangaikondan module plant (first module 29 June) and cell plant (Q4 FY27) remain on schedule.

financial_highlights.change: Down sharply; prior-quarter level referenced as ~16%

financial_highlights.value: 76 MW (cited as ~75 MW later on call)

segments.name: Module – large accounts / IPP / utility / C&I (non-DCR)
segments.commentary: Base-load book of ~7.1 GW with tighter margins; management says pass-through under MSAs applies to cells only, not balance-of-materials. Price realisation for mid-market expected ~INR0.50/Wp higher.

segments.name: Module – DCR
segments.commentary: 76 MW sold in Q1 at materially higher realisation (DCR ~INR22+/Wp per management). Cell supply is from external domestic partners until own cell line starts; DCR volume expected to grow 2–2.5x each quarter.

segments.name: Distribution channel
segments.commentary: Monthly run rate roughly doubled from ~40 MW last year; network of 119+ distributors and 757+ dealers across 24 states. Management says distribution pricing is spot-linked and realises INR1–1.5/Wp above key accounts.

segments.name: BESS (VSL PowerHive)
segments.commentary: 7.5 GWh BESS assembly plant in Chennai: equipment ordered ~3 months ago, delivery Nov 2026, installation Jan 2027, COD from March 2027. First 20 MWh utility-scale order executed; 7.5 GWh LFP cell plant (Phase 1 of 15 GWh) targets COD Q4 FY29, with land and incentives expected by Sept 2026.

guidance_outlook: No updated FY27 guidance; management will revisit at H1 results. Prior FY27 outlook (given 8 May) referenced as including EBITDA of INR1,500–1,600 crore per an analyst's citation; management did not reaffirm it.
Q2 margins expected to remain under some pressure from unabsorbed prices, partly offset by DCR and channel mix; management declined to say whether 16% margin returns.
Gangaikondan cell line (9 GW) on track for commissioning in Q4 FY27, with ramp possibly spilling into Q1 FY28; FY28 cell utilisation targeted at 40–50% (six-month ramp).
Wafer-ingot capacity resized to 9 GW (from 6 GW, part of the 12 GW plan), project cost ~INR5,600 crore; ground-breaking announced for next month.
Capex of ~INR5,000 crore planned for FY27 and similar in FY28; funding targeted at 75:25 debt-equity, ~70:30 once scheme is in place.
capex_capacity: Gangaikondan: 6 GW module (commissioned 29 June 2026, fully funded); module capacity cited as 15.5 GW total across sites, with 9–9.5 GW expected to be deliverable in FY27.
Gangaikondan 9 GW cell plant: civil/PEB advanced, first cell targeted Q4 FY27; ~70% backward integration once live.
Gangaikondan 9 GW wafer/ingot: board approved increase from 6 GW to 9 GW; part of the 12 GW plan, project cost ~INR5,600 crore; phasing shifted with later capacity around FY29.
Earlier 3 GW cell phase kept for FY28 on upgraded (non-TOPCon) technology.
Module portfolio transitioned from M10R to G12R; manpower down ~40% on new automated lines. Production volume in Q1 about 1,085 MW.
demand_pricing: Management attributes weak Q1 order flow to ALMM-2 enforcement uncertainty (C&I 15 GW/yr demand waited); ALMM-2 deferred to December 2026 after the 18 July operating memorandum.
Pricing power in non-DCR is under pressure from oversupply (~210 GW cited); cell oversupply limited pass-through of cost escalation.
Analyst estimate: industry DCR demand revised down to ~17 GW for the year from 20–25 GW as C&I shifts to non-DCR.
Chinese landed cell price cited at ~4 cents/W before 27.5% BCD.
Tender pipeline: ~35–40 GW of fresh utility tenders post-August 2025; FY27 AC market estimated at 30–35 GW utility, ~15 GW C&I, 14–15 GW PM Surya Ghar plus KUSUM.

qa_highlights.question: What was the per-watt spread this quarter, and why was the 88% of order book with cost escalation clauses not passed through? Has the spread improved since ALMM-2 deferment?
qa_highlights.answer: Pass-through under MSAs covers only cells, not balance-of-materials (BOM). Cell oversupply also limited price recovery. EBITDA of INR126 crore on ~1 GW works out to about INR1.25/Wp. Management wants one more quarter before judging DCR vs non-DCR margins.

qa_highlights.question: How much of the ~8 GW order book is executable this year?
qa_highlights.answer: Module capacity is 15.5 GW, with 9–9.5 GW deliverable in FY27. Management will not take negative-margin orders and asked for another quarter of clarity on volumes and pricing.

qa_highlights.question: How does DCR spread compare with non-DCR, given cell makers retain most margin?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said DCR delivers more margin than non-DCR but gave no number. Only 75–76 MW of DCR was sold in Q1, so it is too early to split margins.

qa_highlights.question: Is the 9 GW cell line on track for Q4 commissioning, and will all 9 GW come on stream then?
qa_highlights.answer: Commissioning is on track for Q4 FY27. Ramp-up may spill into Q1 FY28, and the full 9 GW may not be running in Q4.

qa_highlights.question: Will Q2 EBITDA margin return to the ~16% level?
qa_highlights.answer: Not a direct conclusion. Q2 will still see some unabsorbed price impact, partly offset by DCR and channel mix. Management declined to commit to a 16% margin.

qa_highlights.question: Is the Q1 volume driven by an influx of non-DCR orders, and will it normalise?
qa_highlights.answer: Volume depends on backlog and module ramp, and management sees no slowdown. Industry DCR demand estimate was cut to about 17 GW from 20–25 GW as C&I shifts to non-DCR. Country consumption was about 12 GW in the quarter.

qa_highlights.question: Will FY27 production guidance of 7–8 GW and the INR1,500–1,600 crore EBITDA outlook be reaffirmed?
qa_highlights.answer: No guidance was reaffirmed. Management is waiting for ALMM-2 clarity and will revisit at H1 results, citing customer hesitancy and infrastructure delays.

qa_highlights.question: Chinese cell price and wafer-ingot capacity clarification?
qa_highlights.answer: Chinese landed cell price is about 4 cents/W before 27.5% BCD. The wafer-ingot 9 GW is part of the same 12 GW plan, now resized, with project cost about INR5,600 crore.

qa_highlights.question: What is the FY27 and FY28 capex and debt funding plan?
qa_highlights.answer: FY27 capex is about INR5,000 crore, with a similar amount in FY28, mostly debt-funded. Target gearing is 75:25, moving to about 70:30 once the scheme is in place. Disbursements were expected to begin around end-August.

risks_watch: Gross margin recovery: EBITDA margin fell to 8.06% (~INR1.25/Wp). Management gave no Q2 margin number and is waiting for clarity on DCR vs non-DCR margins.
Cost pass-through gap: MSA escalation covers only cells, not BOM, so metals, EVA and freight inflation remain largely unrecovered. Pricing is pressured by ~210 GW of oversupply.
ALMM-2 timing: enforcement was deferred to December 2026 after the 18 July operating memorandum. Further extension talks are ongoing and could shift C&I order timing again.
Cell line execution: Gangaikondan 9 GW cell line is due in Q4 FY27, with ramp possibly into Q1 FY28. The 3 GW phase is pushed to FY28 on non-TOPCon technology.
Order conversion: 7.9 GW order book, but management has not said how much is executable in FY27. The volume outlook depends on customer plans.

Funding: FY27 capex is about INR5,000 crore, with disbursement dependent on debt financial closure still in process. BESS COD is March 2027, and land and incentives for the LFP cell plant are targeted for September 2026.
key_quotes: This quarter, we clocked our highest ever quarterly volume of 1,006 megawatts, up 32% on the same quarter last year.
This was not a broad margin squeeze.
The entire movement sits in a single line, which is the cost of goods sold.
We shared a formal outlook for FY27 on our 8th May call. Given the shape of this quarter and the ramp ahead of us, we will revisit that outlook at our H1 results again.
summary.management_tone: Management was confident on execution milestones (first module on 29 June, cell line on track) and on the DCR and distribution ramp. It was cautious and evasive on margins, FY27 guidance and per-watt spread, repeatedly deferring to one more quarter of clarity.

growth.why: Q1 FY27 volume hit a record 1,006 MW (+32% YoY) and ~INR5,000 cr capex is planned for FY27 with the 6 GW module plant already live and a 9 GW cell line due Q4 FY27, but management withdrew FY27 guidance pending H1, Q2 margins stay under pressure, and the 9 GW cell ramp slips into FY28 at 40-50% utilisation, so growth is supported but not guided.
